entries.title: Isaiah 8:1
segments: ¶And the Lord said to me, Take a great writing-board, and on it put down in common letters, Maher-shalal-hash-baz;

entries.title: Isaiah 8:2
segments: And take true witnesses to the writing, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah, the son of Jeberechiah.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:3
segments: And I went in to my wife, and she became with child, and gave birth to a son. Then the Lord said to me, Give him the name Maher-shalal-hash-baz,

entries.title: Isaiah 8:4
segments: For before the child is able to say, Father, or, Mother, the wealth of Damascus and the goods of Samaria will be taken away by the king of Assyria.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:5
segments: And the Lord said again to me,

entries.title: Isaiah 8:6
segments: Because this people will have nothing to do with the softly-flowing waters of Shiloah, and have fear of Rezin and Remaliah's son;

entries.title: Isaiah 8:7
segments: For this cause the Lord is sending on them the waters of the River, deep and strong, even the king of Assyria and all his glory: and it will come up through all its streams, overflowing all its edges:

entries.title: Isaiah 8:8
segments: And it will come on into Judah; rushing on and overflowing, till the waters are up to the neck; ***and his outstretched wings will be covering the land from side to side: for God is with us.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:9
segments: ¶Have knowledge, O peoples, and be in fear; give ear, all you far-off parts of the earth:

entries.title: Isaiah 8:10
segments: Let your designs be formed, and they will come to nothing; give your orders, and they will not be effected: for God is with us.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:11
segments: For the Lord, controlling me with a strong hand, gave me orders not to go in the way of this people, saying,

entries.title: Isaiah 8:12
segments: Do not say, It is holy, about everything of which this people says, It is holy; and do not be in fear of what they go in fear of.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:13
segments: But let the Lord of armies be holy to you, and go in fear of him, giving honour to him.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:14
segments: And he will be for a holy place: but for a stone of falling and a rock of trouble to the two houses of Israel, and to the men of Jerusalem, for a net in which they may be taken.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:15
segments: And numbers of them, falling on the stone, will be broken, and will be taken in the net.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:16
segments: ¶Let my teaching be kept secret: and my words be given to my disciples only.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:17
segments: And I will be waiting for the Lord, whose face is veiled from the house of Jacob, and I will be looking for him.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:18
segments: See, I and the children whom the Lord has given me, are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of armies, whose resting-place is in Mount Zion.

entries.title: Isaiah 8:19
segments: And when they say to you, Make request for us to those who have control of spirits, and to those wise in secret arts, who make hollow bird-like sounds; is it not right for a people to make request to their gods, to make request for the living to the dead?

entries.title: Isaiah 8:20
segments: Then say to them, Put your faith in the teaching and the witness. ...If they do not say such things. ...For him there is no dawn. ...

entries.title: Isaiah 8:21
segments: And he will go through the land in bitter trouble and in need of food; and when he is unable to get food, he will become angry, cursing his king and his God, and his eyes will be turned to heaven on high;

entries.title: Isaiah 8:22
segments: And he will be looking down on the earth, and there will be trouble and dark clouds, black night where there is no seeing.
